data.Born: Konrad Ernst Otto Zuse · 22 June 1910 · Berlin, Prussia, German Empire
data.Known for: - Z3, Z4 - Plankalkül - Calculating Space (cf. digital physics) - Montagestraße SRS 72 - Helixturm
data.Awards: - Werner von Siemens Ring in 1964 - Harry H. Goode Memorial Award in 1965 (together with George Stibitz) - Wilhelm Exner Medal, 1969 - Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany in 1972 - Computer History Museum Fellow Award in 1999
